name: Anacite
body:
ANACITE
CR 7

XP 3,200
N Medium construct (robot)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, +8 natural)
hp 75 (10d10+20)
Fort +3, Ref +7, Will +5
Defensive Abilities hardness 5, shortwave awareness; Immune construct traits

Weaknesses sunlight dependency

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee 2 claws +15 (1d8+4/19–20 plus grab)
Ranged integrated arc rifle +12 touch (2d6 electricity)

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 14, Con —, Int 17, Wis 10, Cha 11
Base Atk +10; CMB +14 (+18 grapple); CMD 26
Feats Improved Critical (claw), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (claw)
Skills Climb +22, Craft (mechanical) +21, Knowledge (engineering) +21, Perception +10, Stealth +12; Racial Modifiers +8 Craft (mechanical), +8 Knowledge (engineering)
Languages Aklo; remote communication 100 ft.
SQ makers’ masterwork, rebuild, robot upgrades (additional attack (1), additional movement (1), grab, improved hardness, integrated weaponry (1), rapid movement (2), remote communication (3), specialized training (3), 14 total)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Makers’ Masterwork (Ex)

Despite being robots, anacites do not gain vulnerability to critical hits or electricity as robots normally do.

Rebuild (Ex)

Anacite machines are capable of improving and adapting their designs. In a process that takes one day, an anacite may reconfigure any robot upgrades it possesses, replacing them with upgrades of equal value. Anacites can alter themselves at no cost. The standard anacite has 14, which is allocated on the statblock given above.

Shortwave Awareness (Ex)

An anacite can communicate with nearby anacites via invisible waves. In combat, if any allied anacites within 100 feet can act in a surprise round, all of them can.

Sunlight Dependency (Ex)

Anacites gain their energy from light. In areas of darkness, they gain the sickened condition. This ignores a construct’s typical immunity to the sickened condition.

ABOUT

The mutable anacites excel at modifying their own robotic bodies, reconfiguring their abilities to suit any task and overcome any challenge. These adaptations, in conjunction with the anacites’ knack for cooperation and repairs, makes these advanced constructs perfect for long-term projects in extreme environments. The anacites of Aurin have maintained certain locations since the time of the Makers’ War, ensuring that Outer Lord technologies are kept safe and operational.
